title: The Scholarship of Maple Street
author: F. M. Whitlock
blurb: Ines Whitlock, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide who to be when the labels come off before prom.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
